description: Production et distribution d’eau potable is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole Rouen Normandie. This dataset presents the monthly energy consumption for the different water use typologies of the Rouen Normandy Metropolis. Here are the different typologies: “production”: taking over the plants \+ capture “administrative offices” “storage tank” “Pumping station” resuming pumping + surpressor. Coverage: Métropole Rouen Normandie. The portal shows the English title as "Production and distribution of drinking water" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Métropole Rouen Normandie. Its keywords include eau, energie, datagouv, environnement, consommation. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2022-06-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
